post_game_reflections.self_assessment: I initially performed well in the first mission as leader, but unfortunately, failed in the second and third missions. Although I knew Diana was evil, I couldn't quite uncover her role in time. In future games, I want to pay closer attention to potential traitors.

player_observations.Diana: Diana showed exceptional leadership skills and effectively led the team to success in mission 1, but ultimately revealed her true evil intentions. She played her role to perfection, using her influence to manipulate the team.
player_observations.Bob: Despite being good, Bob often found himself in situations that led to the team's downfall. His tendency to take risks and follow Charlie's lead may have contributed to the team's failures.
player_observations.Charlie (Merlin): Charlie provided vital guidance and information, which initially helped the team but later proved detrimental when the evil players discovered his true identity. His ability to influence the outcome was significant.
player_observations.Eve (Assassin): Eve demonstrated remarkable cunning and patience, biding her time before revealing her role. Her presence created tension and uncertainty throughout the game, making it challenging for the good players to stay focused.

post_game_reflections.self_assessment: I think I underestimated the importance of trust and communication among teammates, which led to my failure in revealing the Merlin role and thus failing to complete missions. I made some mistakes in voting and trusting certain players, which ultimately led to my downfall. I could improve by being more cautious and observant of player behavior.

player_observations.Charlie: He played the Merlin role perfectly, remaining completely undercover and providing crucial guidance without raising any suspicion. His ability to stay anonymous was impressive.
player_observations.Diana: She was an effective Assassin, playing her role convincingly and making strategic decisions to take out key players. Her ability to manipulate others and play both sides added to the challenge.
player_observations.Alice: As a Good player, she was relatively quiet and didn't draw much attention to herself, but she made some valuable contributions to our missions. She seemed to be observant and paid attention to the game state.
player_observations.Eve: The Assassin role suited her, as she was very good at playing her character's strengths and staying hidden until her crucial moment. Her ability to blend in and avoid suspicion was impressive.

post_game_reflections.self_assessment: As Merlin, I feel I underestimated the Assassin's ability to move undetected between teams, leading to my own downfall. I also struggled to correctly deduce the roles and loyalties in Mission 3 and 4. Improvement would come from better communication and coordination with good team members.

player_observations.Diana: Diana played the perfect evil role, expertly manipulating the other team members and making the correct moves to block our plans.
player_observations.Bob: Bob was a very cautious player who stuck to the script, but his predictability made it hard for me as Merlin to utilize him effectively in the mission.
player_observations.Alice: Alice was impressive in her ability to keep her true allegiance hidden, only revealing it too late. Her playstyle as a good knight was quite strategic, often helping our team's objectives indirectly.
player_observations.Eve: Eve's presence as an Assassin made it incredibly hard to identify the traitor on our team, and I struggled to trust anyone due to her constant movements and subtle actions. Her ability to stay hidden is a significant strength.
player_observations.Charlie: I had to be careful not to reveal too much about myself as the game progressed, but overall, I think Charlie (myself) played the role well and made some good strategic decisions, even if they weren't enough to save the game.

post_game_reflections.self_assessment: I successfully manipulated the mission results by positioning myself correctly at various times, effectively playing on my role as the evil servant of Merlin. My strategy of working with Bob on Mission 1 paid off significantly as we were able to complete the mission without fail, which later allowed Charlie to remain oblivious to our true intentions even longer. However, I could have been more patient with Eve's progress and played my hand carefully on missions to avoid any potential fails.

player_observations.Charlie: Charlie played his role as Merlin convincingly, but his trust in others and lack of suspicion towards evil players cost him significantly. He took a considerable amount of time to realize the presence of evil agents.
player_observations.Bob: Bob played a good overall game, consistently working with his teammates and staying loyal to the good faction. However, his inexperience with the mission failure mechanic led him to underestimate the risks associated with trusting others.
player_observations.Alice: Alice's gameplay pattern was predictable and somewhat naive, which allowed the evil players to exploit her confidence. Despite this, she showed great teamwork spirit and played well within her assigned roles.
player_observations.Eve: Eve was a challenging player to work with as she was extremely cautious, which hindered the evil faction's ability to make significant progress at times. However, her strategic moves often led to successful outcomes for the evil players.

post_game_reflections.self_assessment: I effectively executed my goals as the assassin, ensuring team evil's victory. However, I sometimes struggled to distinguish between Merlin and the Servant, leading to some close calls. Improving my ability to assess team member reliability would enhance my overall performance.

player_observations.Alice: Alice had a very consistent and transparent playstyle, often revealing her intentions and never attempting to mislead or deceive. Her role as a good character was well-executed.
player_observations.Bob: Bob initially played conservatively, trying to remain incognito, but later became less cautious, which, unfortunately for him, made it easier to identify his good role. His role as a good character was well-played, albeit with a slightly unorthodox approach.
player_observations.Charlie (Merlin): Charlie's Merlin character excelled at gathering crucial information from the team, but occasionally made some questionable decisions in their final rounds, which ultimately had little impact on the game. Their ability to stay hidden for an extended period was commendable.
player_observations.Diana: Diana excelled at her evil role, consistently making impactful decisions that pushed the team towards victory. She expertly balanced her need for information with the requirement to maintain a low profile.
